question: Can existing source-native and geometry-anchored evidence be converted into explicit depth, support, and camera-angular boundary uncertainty supervision without complete truth?

factor_contract.depth_uncertainty_m: Preserve the existing metric uncertainty proxy with factor-specific validity, quality tier, provenance and UNKNOWN closure. Source-native Bonn retains its sensor quantization proxy instead of inventing model error truth.
factor_contract.support_uncertainty_probability: Combine support decision-margin ambiguity, metric-depth uncertainty relative to depth tolerance, and the gravity support-plane fit residual. It is valid only where support truth, tier and plane evidence are valid.
factor_contract.boundary_angular_uncertainty_rad: Convert the existing pixel localization uncertainty into the maximum camera-ray angular displacement induced in plus/minus x/y directions. This removes raster and focal-length units from the uncertainty factor.
factor_contract.unknown: Every factor has an independent valid/UNKNOWN mask, tier and provenance. Invalid value is NaN, invalid tier/provenance is zero, and UNKNOWN is the exact complement of valid.
factor_contract.bonn_support: All Bonn support uncertainty remains UNKNOWN because Bonn FIT has no gravity/support-plane evidence.

distribution_audit.interpretation: ARKit/TUM support and all three boundary-angular uncertainty fields are non-degenerate. Bonn depth uncertainty is intentionally the constant source quantization bound, not a claim of empirical depth error calibration.

analytic_invariants: camera-angular uncertainty is invariant when raster coordinates, intrinsics and pixel radius are scaled together
UNKNOWN remains NaN with zero tier/provenance
support uncertainty increases toward the decision boundary
93/93 payloads satisfy shape, finite-value, bounds, UNKNOWN, tier and provenance closure

decision.next_execution: Add masked uncertainty heads and run a FIT-only learnability canary. Depth and boundary may consume all three sources; support must consume only ARKit/TUM and keep Bonn UNKNOWN.

claim_boundary: Factor-specific source-anchored/proxy uncertainty supervision materialization only. The labels are not calibrated probabilistic ground truth and do not establish student learnability, complete geometry truth, task utility, formal F1 authorization, safety, deployment, or product performance.
